title: Quiz Studio Remediation Request
description: A self-contained transport envelope handing a finalized Learner Response and a Teacher Review to an external human/AI/agent, asking for a targeted remediation Translation Document back. This is an export/transport artifact, not a canonical learning record; the canonical records are the embedded learnerResponse and teacherReview.

learnerResponse.description: A faithful portable copy of the canonical quiz-studio.learner-response contract. Validate it against learner-response.schema.json and the runtime validateLearnerResponse() boundary.

teacherReview.description: A faithful copy of the canonical quiz-studio.teacher-review contract that reviewed the embedded learnerResponse. Validate it against teacher-review.schema.json and the runtime validateTeacherReview() boundary.
